With a private seasonally heated pool and peek-a-boo Gulf views from balconies, this isn’t just a home—it’s an experience. Located just 150 steps from private beach access and pristine sugar-white sands it offers seasonal beach setups for your enjoyment. Take advantage of the 8 provided bikes to explore the nearby charm of Rosemary and Alys Beaches. Just steps from the beach, this outdoor space is perfect for relaxation and fun.Private seasonally heated pool with loungersGrilling area, outdoor dining for 6 and cozy shaded lounge seatingLarge 2nd-floor balcony overlooking the private pool with peek-a-boo Gulf views3rd-floor balcony with Gulf views, outdoor seating, and a bistro table for 4 – perfect for a nightcapOnly 150 steps to the gated community’s private beach access*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Queen Guest Bedroom with 1 Queen Bed, smart TV with dedicated bathroomFull hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo2nd Floor:Primary Suite with 1 King Bed, smart TV, balcony access and en-suite bathroomKing Guest Bedroom with 1 King Bed, smart TV, balcony access and Jack-and-Jill bathroomQueen Guest Bedroom with 1 Queen Bed, 1 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and 1 Twin Trundle Bed, with an access to Jack-and-Jill bathroom (sleeps 5)Shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom with tub/shower combo3rd Floor:King Guest Bedroom with 1 King Bed, smart TV, balcony access and en-suite bathroom with tiled walk-in showerPrimary Suite with 1 King Bed, balcony access, cozy reading sofa with en-suite bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the exclusive Sandy Shores gated community, “Sea For Miles” offers unmatched convenience to the best of 30A.
